title: The 1-rep max calculator throws away a weight or reps typed or pasted in Hindi digits
what: The weight and reps boxes of the 1-rep max calculator keep only the digits 0-9. A number typed on a keyboard set to Hindi digits, or pasted from a Hindi message (for example 82.5 written in Devanagari), is dropped character by character, so the box stays empty or keeps only the dot, and no estimate appears. The mobile number boxes in the same app already turn Hindi digits into 0-9. The same cleaning rule is shared with the other weight boxes of the app.
expected: Hindi and other Indian-script digits are turned into 0-9 before the weight and reps are cleaned, the same way the mobile boxes do.
who: members who type or paste Hindi digits
how_often: every time such a number is entered
fix_line: Convert Indian-script digits to 0-9 at the start of the shared weight cleaning step

items.reason: Crispy Curves: roster phone 2 of 2, check-in phone 1 of 2 app members, plan start and end 1 of 1, app link 0 of 2, trainer 0 of 2, birthday 1 of 2, batch 0 of 2. This area's features use phone (Find my gym, check-in), check-in phone, plan dates (Gym tab membership) and trainer (trainer's measurements on Body). Birthday and batch are read by no screen in this area (grep of the area files finds no birthday or batch). The app link field has no reader at all (grep of supabase, apps/mobile/src and deploy finds no appUserId); the app ties a member to the roster by mobile and first name instead (supabase/migrations/0023_member_membership.sql:70-87).

The check-in phone is asked at the first QR check-in (NO_PHONE answer, then a mobile box). Linking to the gym is asked on the Gym tab (join card with poster scanner), by the gym's invite link, and by Find my gym (behind the Plus switch), which pre-fills the saved number and first name. Plan dates and trainer are filled by the gym desk, not the member, so no phone screen should ask for them.

Rule applied. Trainer is set for 0 of 2 members, but the Body page shows trainer measurements only when they exist and makes no promise in words. App link is 0 of 2, but nothing reads it, so no feature here depends on it. The join promise about a trainer's plan is already FN-B-switch-phone-onboarding-db-b-02 (another area).

Drove the real mobile cleaning step of the Find my gym box with 11 pastes and autofills: '+91 98765 43210', '+91-98765-43210', '098765 43210', '0091 98765 43210', '(+91) 98765-43210', '+919876543210', the same wrapped in invisible direction marks, Hindi digits with and without +91, a trailing space and a trailing newline: all became 9876543210, and no length limit cuts them. Name boxes allow 10 more characters than the 60-character check, so a long pasted name is reported, not cut. The link box limit (200) matches its own check. The 1-rep max weight and reps boxes drop Hindi digits (new finding 01). Find my gym pre-fills a short saved number from Edit profile: already FN-B-switch-phone-components-2-b-01.
Rule applied: no mobile or name box here cuts a real autofill; the weight and reps boxes refuse Hindi digits (finding 01).
